senses: to esteem, be prized, be valuable, be precious, be costly, be appraised
to be precious, be highly valued, be esteemed, be costly

strongs.def: properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit)
strongs.kjv: be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw
